scope: fixed production 1311x603 battle layout; development evidence from B16
method: Agent source-pixel review: fixed left/right activation banners, independently known sides from preceding live entries; user confirmed the example timestamps. Screen edge without matching local layout is insufficient.
limitations: Not human independent ground truth or a held-out layout validation.
Does not identify a unique instance when multiple same-species individuals are active on the same side.
Does not establish weather, an HP amount, an effect cause, native ability or item consumption.
